name: Ubuntu virtual machine
description: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, a private network interface, and a managed OS disk. Uses an existing resource group and subnet. No public IP or inbound firewall rules are created.

fields.label: Subscription
fields.description: The subscription where GitHub's deployment identity has access.

fields.label: Resource group
fields.description: An existing resource group; Stratus does not create it.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: Must match the existing virtual network's region.

fields.label: Environment
fields.description: Applied as an Azure resource tag.

fields.label: VM size
fields.description: Availability and quota are checked by Azure during deployment.

fields.label: OS disk size (GiB)
fields.description: Standard SSD managed disk. This template creates new VMs only.

fields.label: SSH public key
fields.description: Paste your RSA public key (ssh-rsa ...). Never paste a private key. AI will not invent a key.

fields.label: Existing subnet resource ID
fields.description: An existing subnet in the same subscription and region. Network access follows that subnet's policies.

implementations.description: Compiles Bicep and deploys through Azure Resource Manager.
AzureRM provider with remote Azure Blob state and a saved plan.
Native Azure Resource Manager JSON template.
Az PowerShell cmdlets create the NIC and Linux VM.
DSC v3 command resource manages the VM through the shared ARM template.
Azure collection provisions the NIC and VM using the Azure CLI identity.
